name: Healing Potion Tiers
author: vkays
description: Adds three new consumable healing potions above vanilla's Extra Healing, each with its own recolored icon art (built with mdl16_format.recolor_icon_in_place -- confirmed working in-game): Great Healing (gold/amber), Superior Healing (blue/silver), and Supreme Healing (violet). Each heals more than the last and removes critical hits. Requires the test-pocket mod to also be enabled (adds three more chest reward actions to its Test Pocket.zax, on top of the necklace) -- open Lucia's chest in the Test Pocket to receive all three.
